We need to identify crimes based on the fact: From 2011 to Oct 2013, defendant 虚构从事资金拆借生意需要资金等借款理由，承诺6%以上的月息，向朱某甲吸收款项人民币8660.2万元，支付本息人民币8484.2万元，未能偿还数额为人民币176万元。

He promised high interest, collected funds, paid most but not all. This is typical "诈骗罪" (fraud) – specifically "集资诈骗罪" (illegal fundraising fraud). Under Chinese criminal law, "非法集资" is a crime of "非法集资罪" (but actually the crime is "集资诈骗罪" under article 176 of Criminal Law). Also could be "非法吸收公众存款罪" if he attracted public deposits without approval. However the fact says he attracted from a single person (朱某甲) 86.6 million, not necessarily public. Could be "诈骗罪" (fraud) because he promised high interest and didn't repay. The amount is large, so "诈骗罪" with "数额巨大" qualifies. Also could be "非法吸收公众存款罪" if the victim is not a public but a single person? The law defines "非法吸收公众存款罪" as raising funds from the public (more than 2 persons) without approval. Here only one person, so maybe not. So the direct support is "诈骗罪". Also possibly "非法集资罪" but that is not a separate crime; the crime is "集资诈骗罪". So we list "诈骗罪". The fact mentions "虚构...借款理由" and "承诺6%以上的月息" typical of "集资诈骗". So we can list "诈骗罪". If multiple, we could also include "非法吸收公众存款罪" but not directly supported because only one victim.
